title: Price a dedicated GPU against a daily traffic curve
brief:
A dedicated GPU is only cheap per token when it is busy. Your traffic follows office hours, so the GPU is busy for part of the day and mostly idle for the rest. Work out the **effective cost per million tokens** over a full day, using these illustrative numbers (not real quotes):

- One GPU rented at **$2.80 per hour**, running all 24 hours.
- Full-load throughput: **2,000 tokens per second**.
- Traffic: **10 busy hours** at **70%** average utilisation, and **14 quiet hours** at **10%**.
- The shared API you would compare against charges **$0.90 per million tokens**.

Then decide which option is cheaper for this traffic shape (see 1.1).
steps: Compute the tokens the GPU serves per hour at full load, in millions.
Compute the tokens served in the busy hours and in the quiet hours, then add them for the daily total.
Compute the daily GPU cost (it is billed for all 24 hours).
Divide the daily cost by the daily tokens in millions to get the effective cost per million tokens, and compare it with $0.90.
Enter the effective cost per million tokens.
answerFormat: number, in USD per million tokens

solution.walkthrough:
**1. Full-load rate.** 2,000 tokens/s × 3,600 s = 7,200,000 tokens per hour = **7.2 M tokens/h**.

**2. Daily tokens.** Busy: 10 h × 7.2 M × 0.70 = 50.4 M. Quiet: 14 h × 7.2 M × 0.10 = 10.08 M. Total: **60.48 M tokens** per day.

**3. Daily cost.** 24 h × $2.80 = **$67.20**. The quiet hours cost exactly as much as the busy ones.

**4. Effective cost.** $67.20 ÷ 60.48 M = **$1.11 per million tokens**.

**Decision.** $1.11 is more than the shared API's $0.90, so for this traffic shape the shared API is cheaper. The GPU averages only 35% utilisation (60.48 ÷ (7.2 × 24) = 0.35). At a steady 70% around the clock it would cost $2.80 ÷ (7.2 × 0.7) ≈ $0.56 per M and win. Same GPU, same price: the traffic pattern decides, which is why 1.1 asks for a clear business case before switching. Scaling down overnight would also help, at the price of cold starts.
